SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        COALESCE(sd.envsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.lightsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.tempsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.humiditysensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.vibrasensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.pollutantsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.pestsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.handlesensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.transportsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.displaysensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.storagesensitivity, '0')
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration_criteria
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases AS sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
LIMIT 10;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        COALESCE(sd.envsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.lightsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.tempsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.humiditysensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.vibrasensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.pollutantsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.pestsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.handlesensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.transportsensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.displaysensitivity, '0') +
        COALESCE(sd.storagesensitivity, '0')
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration_criteria
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases AS sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.envsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.lightsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.tempsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.humiditysensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.vibrasensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.pollutantsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.pestsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.handlesensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.transportsensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.displaysensitivity AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(sd.storagesensitivity AS INTEGER), 0)
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration_criteria
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases AS sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ar.deteriorrate AS rapid_deterioration,
    ac.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    ac.artname AS artifact_name,
    sc.showcasematerial AS display_case_material,
    sc.sealcondition AS seal_condition,
    sc.maintstatus AS maintenance_status,
    sc.filterstatus AS filter_status,
    sc.silicagelstatus AS silica_gel_status,
    sc.silicagelchangedate AS silica_gel_change_date,
    sc.humiditybuffercap AS humidity_buffer_capacity,
    sc.pollutantabsorbcap AS pollutant_absorb_capacity,
    sc.leakrate AS leak_rate,
    sc.pressurepa AS pressure,
    sc.inertgassysstatus AS inert_gas_system_status,
    sc.firesuppresssys AS fire_suppression_system,
    sc.empowerstatus AS emergency_power_status,
    sc.backupsysstatus AS backup_system_status,
    (
        CASE WHEN sd.envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN sd.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS sensitive_factors_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN ar.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS accelerated_deterioration_criteria
FROM 
    artifactscore AS ac
JOIN 
    artifactratings AS ar ON ac.artregistry = ar.artref
JOIN 
    usagerecords AS ur ON ac.artregistry = ur.artrefused
JOIN 
    showcases AS sc ON ur.showcaserefused = sc.showcasereg
JOIN 
    sensitivitydata AS sd ON ac.artregistry = sd.artref
LIMIT 10;
